title: Registro de auditoría
description: Immutable audit trail viewer (Module H, tpl.workspace-list). Filters over AuditLog (entity_type, action, actor, date range) feed one data-table: occurred_at, actor (— sistema when actor_user_id is null), action, entidad (entity_type + entity_id link to its detail screen), compañía. Clicking a row opens the read-only before/after JSON diff viewer (organism.audit-trail-viewer, rendered as a drilldown per pattern.drilldown_never_new_tab). Info-banner states the append-only guarantee: no UPDATE/DELETE grants at the DB level. Data: AuditLog(*) joined to UserAccount(email) and Company(name, code).

sections.title: Eventos de auditoría
sections.description: AuditLog rows, newest first. actor renders UserAccount.email via actor_user_id, or '— sistema' for job-originated writes (actor_user_id null). entidad renders entity_type + a short entity_id ref that deep-links to the entity's detail screen (dynamic per entity_type: LicenseRequest → SCR-request-detail, Company → SCR-company-detail, Person → SCR-person-detail, VendorAccount → SCR-vendor-account-detail, Statement → SCR-statement-detail); no single static target, so the link lives on the cell, not the row. compañía renders Company.name (code) via company_id, or '—' for global events. Row click opens the read-only before/after diff (modal_audit_diff), rendered as a drilldown per pattern.drilldown_never_new_tab.

sections.title: Detalle del cambio
sections.description: Read-only before/after JSON diff viewer (organism.audit-trail-viewer) over AuditLog.before / AuditLog.after. Pure inspection: no commit affordance, no states beyond default. Removed keys tinted with semantic error background, added keys with success background — always paired with +/- markers, never color alone. Incluye el campo "Nota" (justificación del actor) cuando la acción la exigió (reclamos de deriva, rotaciones, desactivaciones, retiros de rol, propuestas mantenidas).

fields.label: Antes

fields.label: Después
fields.help: Estado del registro después del cambio (— para eliminaciones lógicas).

sections.title: Registro inmutable
sections.content: Este registro es de solo escritura a nivel de base de datos: sin permisos de edición ni borrado (append-only). Cada acción que modifica datos en Ledger escribe aquí su antes y después, así que lo que ves es la evidencia completa, sin huecos.
